text_block_list.text:
Just half a month left until the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown route, the 
Satsuki Sho. The racing world was buzzing 
with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead, Jungle Pocket has a 
two-length lead! Jungle Pocket crosses the 
finish line in first!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon wins with ease—!!
(UOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look at this page, amazing! 
Pokke-chan and Tachyon-chan are featured 
so big!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So many interviews too... Wait, an 
eight-page spread?!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Everyone's hopes for this 
year's Classic series are packed so 
tightly together.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm! Well... On the other hand, I just 
wrote a single determined line in the 
corner. That just means it's time for me 
to do my best from here on, right?

"It's true that in terms of buzz, she 
still lags behind her peers. But surely, 
that won't last long."
choice_data_list:
I'll catch up in no time. It's nothing to 
worry about.
I'll catch up soon enough, no big deal!

text_block_list.text:
The world will surely realize it soon: 
Dants Flame's strength and brilliance. 
When I told her that—

The gaze from those round eyes locked onto 
me firmly and wouldn't look away.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah! O-Oh, sorry! Um, I was just so happy—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If you'd like, after this... would you 
want to go grab a bite to eat?"

There was no way I'd turn down such a 
lovely invitation. We shared a meal, 
enjoyed some idle chatter, and just as we 
caught our breath...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...There's something I'd like to 
ask.

Dantsu Flame wore an unusually serious 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Could you please listen to what I have to 
say?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, we moved around 
all the time because of my father's job.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You arrive at a new place, stay for a bit, 
then leave and head off to somewhere new 
again—

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: I'm Dantsu Flame! It's great to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet ya! Are your legs really 
fast? There are tons of Umamusume at my 
school!

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
The biology committee takes turns feeding 
the animals. Are you okay with bugs? Um—

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dantsu! It's Dantsu Flame~.

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what is everyone doing for this 
year's school play? I... really want to 
play Cinderella!

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds awesome~! Hey, you should 
totally play Cinderella! And I wanna play 
the Fairy Godmother!

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, you both look amazing in them!

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate E
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Dants-chan, you're transferring 
again!?"

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thank you for being my friend all 
this time!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Say hello. Put on a smile. Become 
friends. Play together. Transfer schools. 
Say hello."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The more schools I transferred to, the 
better I got at one thing—fitting in with 
the people around me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Keep smiling so it's easy to blend in. 
Keep both words and attitude gentle and 
soft—be careful.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
As the days repeated like that, I came to 
realize something.

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate F
text_block_list.text: *sniff*, *sniffle*...

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong? Are you okay? If you'd 
like, I'm here to lis—

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate F
text_block_list.text:
Ah... D-Dants Flame-chan, right! No, it's 
nothing really—

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate G
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate F
text_block_list.text: ...! Waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate G
text_block_list.text:
Ow, wait, what's wrong? Hey, calm down. 
Let's talk over there.

text_block_list.name: Old Classmate F
text_block_list.text: You know, my mom and dad—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I'm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it doesn't have a physical form?" 
she wondered.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: ...The letters stopped coming again.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: It... can't be helped, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Did you finish the scarf? Did you do 
gymnastics formations at sports day this 
year too?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I hope we get the same school trip 
destination. I already found a sweet treat 
I'd love to try!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The things I wanted to share kept piling 
up, while the places I could send them 
only dwindled. Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I ran in a race!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I remember it clearly. That 
little kids' race I casually entered after 
being invited.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The school grounds in the early afternoon. 
The warm breeze, the scent of dirt. The 
murmurs, the applause, countless eyes 
watching—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame crosses the finish line! The 
winner is Dantsu Flame!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
After I crossed the finish line, an 
excited young girl pointed at me and 
shouted.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —I remember now, "Dants Flame"!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...— They were... watching me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
They were talking about me, bringing me 
up—none other than me...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was standing in the 
center of the podium, clutching the medal 
so tightly my fingers hurt.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The medal is heavy, large—and special.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: (I want to win even more.)

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win more and shine the 
brightest. To stand in the center and 
become the star.)

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: (If I do that, then surely—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That even someone like me could become 
special.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...And ever since that day, I gained a 
dream: to become the lead and stand in the 
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― S-Sorry! I guess I just got a little 
carried away!
choice_data_list:
You shared something that important with 
me?

...You're sharing something that important 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...And as for you, Trainer—

"She's a special girl, one capable of 
becoming the leading figure of a new era!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: They believe that I have a tangible form.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's... actually an amazing thing! For 
example—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...For instance, even if I get fewer 
magazine interviews, I can feel totally 
fine about it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like... as long as the two 
of us work hard together, we can do it...! 
So—

Dantsu Flame blinks her eyes. Her eyes, 
which always hold a gentle smile, were wet 
with tears for today only.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I'm with you, Trainer, I can 
make my dreams come true."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...It's true, really and truly.

I knew she possessed passionate feelings, 
but—

Perhaps at its core, it was a craving born 
from a loneliness sleeping deep within her 
heart.

Before I knew it, one word had led to 
another.
choice_data_list:
I want to make your existence known to the 
entire world.
I want to make the world know about you.

text_block_list.text:
No matter what it takes. Otherwise, it 
would just be far too wasteful.

To think the world could keep overlooking 
such a dedicated girl, who doesn't know 
the meaning of defeat.
choice_data_list:
Let's make our dreams come true together, 
no matter what

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, um, I didn't think... you'd say 
something like that to me, so, um—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Please... make my dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Together... with me...!
